1275|fe52f4ea.name: Kyra Boucher
1275|fe52f4ea.text: Just browsing my wares or is there something specific I can help you find today?

1416|c14f3f06.name: Grimand Elmore
1416|c14f3f06.text:
If you've come looking for the finest craftsmanship on this or any other continent in the world, then you've come to the right place!

Grimand Elmore, at your service!

1430|0c543544.name: Tomas
1430|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

2329|a28d29e1.name: Michelle Belle
2329|a28d29e1.text: I can train you in First Aid techniques.

240|3ccc4430.name: Marshal Dughan
240|3ccc4430.text: Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up! I hope you have good news, $N...

251507|af6809a8.name: Josephine Carson
251507|af6809a8.text: Greetings, $c. I can teach you skills and techniques.

258930|0e051c59.name: Isaac Chan
258930|0e051c59.text: You've come for training in order to pass it on to your pets?

1097-complete.name: Grimand Elmore
1097-complete.text: You're here to help with my delivery?  Very good!
1097-complete.title: Elmore's Task

114-complete.name: Maybell Maclure
114-complete.text:
Oh...my!  I feel guilty deceiving my family, but my feelings for Tommy Joe are too strong to ignore.

Thank you, $N.  I'll drink this liquor as soon as I have the chance and sneak away to my love.

And for you... please take this.
114-complete.title: The Escape

114-progress.name: Maybell Maclure
114-progress.text: Did you deliver my letter to Tommy Joe?  What did he say??
114-progress.title: The Escape

353-accept.name: Grimand Elmore
353-accept.text:
The Stormpikes are a respected dwarven clan, and are well known for their fine and discerning tastes.  So it's no wonder that Gringer Stormpike, a Mountaineer of Ironforge, commissioned me to craft him a weapon.

The weapon is finished, but... Mountaineer Stormpike is far away, in distant Loch Modan.  If you plan on traveling to the north, can you deliver this package to him?

My last message from Mountaineer Stormpike said he's stationed at the northern guard tower in Loch Modan.
353-accept.title: Stormpike's Delivery

47-complete.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-complete.text: Thanks for the dust, $N.  Here's your cash, and...here is a token from associates of mine.  You might find it useful...useful.
47-complete.title: Gold Dust Exchange

47-progress.name: Remy "Two Times"
47-progress.text: Psst!  You have that Gold Dust for me...for me?
47-progress.title: Gold Dust Exchange

60-complete.name: William Pestle
60-complete.text: You were busy hunting kobolds, were you?  Thanks for the candles, $N, and here's your reward...
60-complete.title: Kobold Candles

60-progress.name: William Pestle
60-progress.text: Did you gather those candles yet?
60-progress.title: Kobold Candles

61-accept.name: William Pestle
61-accept.text:
My brother Morgan is waiting in Stormwind for my shipment of candles.  I don't have enough time to make the trip myself, but if you'd like to take him the shipment, he'll pay you well.

I've packed up the candles, and you can find Morgan in our shop, Pestle's Apothecary, in the Stormwind Trade District.
61-accept.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-complete.name: Morgan Pestle
61-complete.text: Here is your payment ... and while you're here, take a look around!  I'm sure we have a potion or other trinket you'd find useful.
61-complete.title: Shipment to Stormwind

61-progress.name: Morgan Pestle
61-progress.text: Oh, a shipment from my brother?  Splendid!  Fortune truly shines on me today!
61-progress.title: Shipment to Stormwind

62-complete.name: Marshal Dughan
62-complete.text: This is bad news.  What's next, dragons?!?  We'll have to increase our patrols near that mine.  Thanks for your efforts, $N.  And hold a moment... I might have another task for you.
62-complete.title: The Fargodeep Mine

76-accept.name: Marshal Dughan
76-accept.text:
Thanks to you we know the Fargodeep Mine is infested with kobolds.  Now we need a scout to investigate the more distant Jasperlode Mine.

Explore Jasperlode and confirm any kobold presence.  To reach the mine, travel east along the road until you reach the Tower of Azora.  From the tower, head north and you'll find the mine in the foothills.
76-accept.title: The Jasperlode Mine

87-complete.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-complete.text:
Oh, you found it!  Thank you, thank you dear!

Here, take this.  It was my husband's and he always said it was lucky.  If only he didn't forget it on his last campaign! *sniff*
87-complete.title: Goldtooth

87-progress.name: "Auntie" Bernice Stonefield
87-progress.text: Hello, $N.  Have you found my necklace?
87-progress.title: Goldtooth

91775-progress.name: Marshal Dughan
91775-progress.text: Have you found all the books yet?
91775-progress.title: Book Return

94792-accept.name: Josephine Carson
94792-accept.text:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a $c.
94792-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94792-progress.name: Josephine Carson
94792-progress.text: You will learn, $N, and one day you will be a great $c.
94792-progress.title: Taming the Beast

94793-accept.name: Josephine Carson
94793-accept.text:
You now have the power to tame a pet, but you must also gain the skills to train it. For this, there is none better than Isaac Chan, a lifelong woodsman. He will give you the ability to train your new pet.

Go with the winds, young $c.
94793-accept.title: Training the Beast

94793-complete.name: Isaac Chan
94793-complete.text:
A fledgling $c, I see. Yes, I can bestow you with the skills you need to train and guide your pet. Not only will you be able to teach your pet new abilities, you will now be able to feed your pet, as well as revive it, should it fall in battle.

Remember, $N, always respect the balance and live in awe of nature around you. Now, go forth. We shall speak again, at a later date.
94793-complete.title: Training the Beast

94863-accept.name: Josephine Carson
94863-accept.text:
You've already mastered taming a boar. Now it's time for the next lesson. The forest holds fiercer companions, and with care, you can earn their trust.

Take this Taming Rod and seek out a Gray Forest Wolf. Remember, nature's balance must be respected. Prove your skill as a $c once more.
94863-accept.title: Taming the Beast

94864-progress.name: Josephine Carson
94864-progress.text: Go forth, $N, and tame the burliest of Elwynn beasts.
94864-progress.title: Taming the Beast
